title: Twelve Monkeys Mangabeys Iced Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Mangabeys Iced by Twelve Monkeys is a vibrant tropical blend featuring juicy Guava, sweet Mango, and tangy Pineapple, rounded out with an array of tropical fruit notes. The addition of a cooling menthol finish enhances the exotic fruit medley, delivering a smooth, refreshing vape with every inhale. Crafted with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Mangabeys Iced is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) vape devices, providing dense vapour clouds and smooth yet full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to adjust their nicotine strength to suit their preference. If you prefer this flavour without the cooling sensation, the original un-iced version is also available right here at Vapestore. Twelve Monkeys is a globally recognised Canadian e-liquid brand known for pushing the boundaries of flavour innovation. Their expertly crafted blends bring together high-quality ingredients and bold fruit combinations, offering a premium vaping experience tailored for fruit and menthol enthusiasts alike.
